how.title: How It Works
how.step1.title: 1. Install & Open
how.step1.body: Add the extension to Chrome and click the icon in your toolbar. You'll see a professional dark interface with profile circles on the left.
how.step2.title: 2. Create Profiles
how.step2.body: Click the "+" circle to create different header configurations. Each profile can have unlimited request and response headers.
how.step3.title: 3. Add Headers
how.step3.body: Use the "Add header" buttons to create custom HTTP headers. Each header has a checkbox to enable/disable individually.
how.step4.title: 4. Instant Results
how.step4.body: Headers are applied in real-time! Switch profiles by clicking numbered circles. Use the pause button to temporarily disable.

features.title: Key Features
features.free.title: 100% Free Forever
features.free.body: No subscriptions, no premium tiers, no feature limitations. Everything is completely free, unlike competitors charging $5-15/month.
features.profiles.title: Unlimited Profiles
features.profiles.body: Create as many header configurations as you need. Most free alternatives limit you to just 3 profiles.
features.languages.title: 7 Languages
features.languages.body: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Русский and Español — switch from the toolbar, or let it follow your browser.
features.realtime.title: Real-time Modification
features.realtime.body: Modify request and response headers instantly using Chrome's latest declarativeNetRequest API. No page refreshes needed!
features.append.title: Set or Append
features.append.body: Toggle any header between set and append mode — perfect for multi-value headers like Accept, Cookie or Accept-Encoding.
features.filters.title: Domain & Tab Group Filters
features.filters.body: Scope a profile to specific domains, or to a Chrome tab group — keep sandbox headers in their tabs and never mix environments again.
features.ui.title: Professional Interface
features.ui.body: Beautiful dark theme with numbered profile circles, checkboxes for individual headers, and intuitive controls.
features.pause.title: Pause Functionality
features.pause.body: Temporarily disable all headers without losing your configurations. Perfect for quick testing comparisons.
features.importExport.title: Import & Export
features.importExport.body: Back up or share your profiles as a JSON file with one click, and import configurations — including profiles exported from ModHeader.
features.privacy.title: Privacy First
features.privacy.body: Zero data collection, zero tracking. All configurations stored locally on your device only.
support.title: Free, and nobody's paying for it
support.body: This extension costs nothing, and no one pays me to maintain it or to build new things into it. It gets better in my own time.
support.issues: Want something improved? Open an issue and let's talk it through — that's free too, and it's the best way in.
support.wink: Chip in and your request moves up my queue. And if you'd rather not, no hard feelings — nobody ever turned down a glass of water ;)
support.footer: Either way, it stays free for everyone.
privacySummary.title: Privacy & Security
privacySummary.noCollection.title: Zero Data Collection
privacySummary.noCollection.body: We don't collect, track, or store any personal information. No analytics, no telemetry, no user data.
privacySummary.local.title: Local Storage Only
privacySummary.local.body: All your header configurations stay on your device using Chrome's secure local storage.
privacySummary.openSource.title: Open Source
privacySummary.openSource.body: Full transparency - inspect the code on GitHub to verify our privacy claims.

privacy.meta.title: Privacy Policy - Header Editor Pro Free Chrome Extension
privacy.meta.description: Privacy policy for Header Editor Pro - Free. Zero data collection, all configurations stored locally. Your privacy is our priority.
privacy.meta.ogTitle: Privacy Policy - Header Editor Pro Free
privacy.meta.ogDescription: Zero data collection. All configurations stored locally on your device.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy - Header Editor Pro - Free
privacy.callout.label: Your Privacy Matters:
privacy.callout.body: This extension is designed with privacy first. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data.
privacy.collection.title: Data Collection
privacy.collection.body: Header Editor Pro - Free does not collect, store, or transmit any personal user data to external servers. The extension operates entirely within your browser and does not communicate with any remote services.
privacy.storage.title: Local Storage
privacy.storage.intro: All header configurations, profiles, and settings are stored locally on your device using the browser's storage API. This data includes:
privacy.storage.outro: This data never leaves your computer and is only accessible by the extension itself. You can clear this data at any time by removing the extension or clearing your browser data.
privacy.permissions.title: Permissions
privacy.permissions.intro: The extension requires the following permissions to function:
privacy.permissions.dnr: To intercept and modify HTTP headers
privacy.permissions.tabGroups: To read the name and colour of a Chrome tab group, so a profile can be scoped to one
privacy.permissions.allUrls: Header rules are applied by the browser itself through declarativeNetRequest. The extension does not read page content, and never sees the requests it modifies.
privacy.permissions.outro: These permissions are used solely for the extension's functionality and not for data collection.
privacy.thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
privacy.thirdParty.body: This extension does not integrate with or send data to any third-party services, analytics platforms, or advertising networks.
privacy.updates.title: Updates to This Policy
privacy.updates.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected in the extension and the updated date below.
privacy.contact.title: Contact
privacy.contact.body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or the extension's data practices, please contact us through the extension's support channels on GitHub.
